name: AML/KYC onboarding stories for the M7 harness (Kestrel Wallet, fictional)

change_history.change: Draft by Claude for Roger's review (M7 step 5).

Roger's suggestions: K03 correspondence address and tax residence (AC5, AC6); K04 AC1 list-change time edge; K08 AC6 12/24-hour display incl. midnight; new K11 business customer (directors, beneficial owners incl. indirect, 25% boundary); new K12 transaction monitoring, a larger story (9 ACs) to check scale and cost.

Roger's review: K01 AC4 says the 120-year limit is Kestrel's own plausibility limit; new K01 AC5 non-existent or wrongly formatted dates; K06 AC3 who maintains the high-risk country list and which version applies; K06 AC4 defines what EDD before opening means (case, source of funds, analyst approval). K01 AC4 made explicit: 121 or older on the submission date is rejected; 120 can continue.

notes: Fictional fintech 'Kestrel Wallet'. Every rule, number, list and reason code is invented for testing the harness; no real regulation, regulator or company is named or quoted. Not compliance guidance.
No expected test ideas (no answer key): the harness is oracle-free.
Same story shape as datasets/testgen_golden.json, so the Day 4 generator prompts and the harness read it unchanged.
EDD cases: K06 opens one before an account exists (HIGH rating); K07 opens one after the account is open (large first deposit). Both ask for a source-of-funds document.

stories.title: Check the applicant's age
stories.i_want: to open an account by entering my date of birth
stories.so_that: I can use Kestrel Wallet if I am old enough

acceptance_criteria.text: The date of birth is required to submit an application.
An applicant who is 18 or over on the date the application is submitted can continue.
An applicant who is under 18 on the date the application is submitted is refused with reason code UNDERAGE.

A date of birth in the future, or one that makes the applicant 121 or older on the date the application is submitted, is rejected with reason code INVALID_DOB and the applicant can correct it. An applicant aged 120 on that date can continue.

The date of birth is entered as DD/MM/YYYY. A date that does not exist (for example 31/02/1990 or 29/02/2001) or is not in that format is rejected with reason code INVALID_DOB and the applicant can correct it.
Accepted documents are a passport, a national identity card or a driving licence. Any other document is refused with reason code DOC_NOT_ACCEPTED.
A document that has expired on or before the submission date is refused with reason code DOC_EXPIRED.
A document that expires within 30 days after the submission date is accepted and flagged EXPIRING_SOON.
The name on the document must match the name entered on the application, ignoring upper and lower case, accents and spaces at the start or end. A mismatch is refused with reason code NAME_MISMATCH.

stories.title: Check the proof of address
stories.i_want: to upload a proof of address

acceptance_criteria.text: Accepted proofs of address are a utility bill, a bank statement or a letter from a government body.
The proof of address must be dated within the 90 days before the submission date. An older proof is refused with reason code ADDRESS_PROOF_OLD.
The address on the proof must match the address entered on the application. A mismatch is refused with reason code ADDRESS_MISMATCH.
A post office box is not accepted as a residential address.
An applicant may also give a separate correspondence address. Only the residential address needs a proof of address, and a post office box is accepted as a correspondence address.

The applicant declares their country of tax residence. If it is different from the country of the residential address, a tax identification number for the country of tax residence is required; otherwise it is not asked for.

stories.title: Screen the applicant against the sanctions list
stories.i_want: every applicant screened against the sanctions list before an account is opened
stories.so_that: we never open an account for a sanctioned person

acceptance_criteria.text: Every application is screened against the sanctions list in force when the application is submitted. The list is replaced every day at 02:00 UTC: an application submitted at 01:59:59 UTC is screened against the previous day's list, and one submitted at 02:00:00 UTC or later against the new list.
A match on full name and date of birth sets the application status to BLOCKED, and the compliance team is alerted.
A match on full name only sets the application status to PENDING_REVIEW for an analyst to decide.
With no match, screening is passed and the application continues.
A blocked applicant is shown the message "We cannot open an account at this time" and is never told about the sanctions match.

stories.title: Screen for politically exposed persons
stories.i_want: applicants who are politically exposed persons (PEPs) identified
stories.so_that: they receive the extra checks they need

acceptance_criteria.text: Every application is checked against the PEP list when the application is submitted.
A PEP match sets the customer's risk rating to HIGH, whatever their risk score.
A PEP application can only be approved by a senior compliance officer.
A close family member or close associate of a PEP is treated as a PEP.

stories.title: Calculate the customer risk rating
stories.i_want: every new customer given a risk rating
stories.so_that: the level of checks matches the risk

acceptance_criteria.text: The risk score is a whole number from 0 to 100.
A score from 0 to 39 is LOW, from 40 to 69 is MEDIUM, and from 70 to 100 is HIGH.

A customer whose country of residence is on the high-risk country list has 30 points added, and the score is capped at 100. The list is maintained by the compliance team; the rating uses the list in force on the day the rating is calculated.

A HIGH rating opens an EDD (enhanced due diligence) case before the account is opened. The applicant is asked for a source-of-funds document, and the account is opened only after an analyst approves the EDD case.

stories.title: Enhanced due diligence on a large first deposit
stories.so_that: the source of the money is understood

acceptance_criteria.text: A first deposit of more than 10,000.00 made within 30 days of the account opening date opens an EDD case.
A first deposit of exactly 10,000.00 does not open an EDD case.
When an EDD case is opened, the customer is asked for a source-of-funds document, which must be received within 14 days.
If the source-of-funds document is not received within 14 days, the account status changes to FROZEN.
A frozen account cannot make withdrawals or transfers until an analyst closes the EDD case.

stories.title: Analyst decision on a referred application
stories.i_want: to approve or reject applications referred for review
stories.so_that: only applications that pass our checks are opened

acceptance_criteria.text: Only a compliance analyst can approve or reject an application with status PENDING_REVIEW.
An analyst cannot decide an application they submitted on behalf of a customer.
Rejecting an application requires a reason chosen from the reason list.
Each decision is recorded with the analyst's ID, the date and time, the decision and the reason.
The applicant is emailed the outcome within 1 business day of the decision.

The decision time is shown to staff in 24-hour format in the analyst's time zone (for example 14:05), and to the applicant in 12-hour format with AM or PM in the applicant's time zone (for example 2:05 PM). A decision at midnight is shown as 00:00 to staff and 12:00 AM to the applicant.

stories.title: Periodic review of existing customers
stories.i_want: customers reviewed again at intervals that match their risk
stories.so_that: their information stays up to date

acceptance_criteria.text: The next review is due 12 months after the last review for HIGH risk, 24 months for MEDIUM risk and 36 months for LOW risk.
A review due date that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next business day.
A customer whose review is overdue at the end of the due date (23:59 in the customer's time zone) has their account status changed to RESTRICTED.
A RESTRICTED account can make withdrawals but not deposits or transfers until the review is completed.

stories.title: Complete the online application
stories.i_want: to complete the application in steps and come back to it later
stories.so_that: I do not have to finish it in one go

acceptance_criteria.text: The application has four steps in this order: personal details, address, documents, declaration.
The applicant must be logged in to start or resume an application.
An application can be saved as a draft at any step and resumed later. A draft not resumed within 30 days is deleted.
When the country of residence is Ireland, the county field is required and offers the 26 counties. For any other country the county field is hidden.
The application cannot be submitted until all four steps are complete.

stories.title: Onboard a business customer
stories.i_want: to identify the directors and beneficial owners of a business applicant
stories.so_that: we know who owns and controls every business customer

acceptance_criteria.text: A business application needs the company name, the company registration number and the country of registration. An application missing any of these cannot be submitted.
Every director must be named, with their full name and date of birth. At least one director is required.

Every beneficial owner must be identified. A beneficial owner is a person who owns or controls more than 25% of the company, directly or indirectly. A person with exactly 25% is not a beneficial owner.

Indirect ownership is worked out through each company in the chain by multiplying the percentages: a person who owns 50% of a company that owns 60% of the applicant owns 30% of the applicant. A person's direct and indirect percentages are added together.
Every director and beneficial owner is screened against the sanctions list and the PEP list in the same way as an individual applicant. A match on any one of them applies to the whole application.
If no person owns or controls more than 25%, the most senior director is recorded as the beneficial owner and the application is flagged NO_OWNER_ABOVE_THRESHOLD.

stories.title: Monitor transactions for suspicious activity
stories.i_want: completed transactions checked against the monitoring rules
stories.so_that: suspicious activity is spotted and investigated

acceptance_criteria.text: Every completed deposit, withdrawal and transfer is checked against the monitoring rules within 5 minutes of completing.
A single transaction of more than 5,000.00 raises alert LARGE_TXN. For a customer with a HIGH risk rating the amount is more than 2,500.00.
Three or more deposits within any 24 hours, each from 4,500.00 to 4,999.99, raise alert STRUCTURING.
More than 10 transfers out in one calendar day, in the customer's time zone, raise alert VELOCITY.
A transfer to or from a country on the high-risk country list raises alert HIGH_RISK_COUNTRY, whatever the amount.
A deposit followed within 48 hours by transfers out totalling 90% or more of that deposit raises alert RAPID_MOVEMENT.
One transaction can raise more than one alert. Each alert is recorded separately with the customer, the transaction, the rule and the date and time.
Two or more alerts for the same customer within 30 days open a case for an analyst. A single alert does not open a case.
Alerts and cases are never shown or mentioned to the customer.
